newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: BPI declares 80 ctv cash dividend.
newsitem.headline: BPI declares 80 ctv cash dividend.

text.p: The Bank of the Philippine Islands (BPI) said on Tuesday that its board of directors had approved an 80 centavo cash dividend to holders of both common and preferred A shares.
The bank still has to seek the approval of the Central Bank on its cash bonus before it can set a record date for the dividend, the bank told the Philippine Stock Exchange.
"A" shares are limited to Filipino investors. The dividend was the third to be declared this year.
BPI is the banking subsidiary of conglomerate Ayala Corp. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
